nom: Dr.Reju-All Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum 1.01 Fl Oz

avis.titre: Deceiving
avis.texte: it's meh. It's the usual with these products. PDRN 1,200 parts per million. Translation= very little PDRN. Copper Peptides 1% = nothing. Hyaluronic Acid 0.02%. So what's left is you're paying for a lot of synthetics: glycerin, solvents, alcohol. Yes they leave your skin looking glassy, they moisturize a bit, but they don't really contain enough actives to do what is says it will do.

avis.titre: Hydrating Serum That Leaves Skin Looking Refreshed
avis.texte: I’ve been pleasantly surprised by this serum. It has a lightweight, silky texture that spreads easily and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue. It fits nicely into both my morning and evening skincare routine and layers well with moisturizer. After using it consistently for a few weeks, my skin felt more hydrated and looked smoother and healthier overall. It gave my complexion a nice, refreshed appearance, and I appreciated that it was gentle enough for regular use without causing irritation. The bottle is easy to use, and a small amount goes a long way, making it feel like a good value. If you’re looking for a serum that focuses on hydration and improving the overall look and feel of your skin, this is definitely one I’d recommend.

avis.titre: My new favorite serum!
avis.texte: I am loving this product! I have only been using for a week or so and already see the differences in my skin. It leaves skin feeling moisturized and dewy, not at all greasy! There is no smell and my skin is looking better each day!

avis.titre: Beautiful Texture and Promising Addition to My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I recently started using this serum and so far I really like the texture and feel of the product. It absorbs nicely into my skin, layers well with my other skincare products, and feels like a high-quality formula. I’m excited to continue using it and see the long-term benefits of adding copper peptides to my routine.

avis.titre: The orange peel look is going away
avis.texte: I love this serum. I'm mid-50's with slightly dry, sensitive skin. My face has become smoother since using this, and I had a small area on my cheek that looked like "orange peel skin". This is helping it go away. The only thing is it's a little tacky for 15 minutes, and then that tacky feeling goes away. I just put up with it for awhile, although I hate sticky skincare. No scent.

avis.titre: Get the Glow!
avis.texte: Who's been gatekeeping on this product? I absolutely love the soothing effect from the application. My face glowed and looked well moisturized all day long. I like that the product didn't have a fragrance. I use at least two different serums on my face, so fragrance-free products are what I usually choose. I'm most pleased with the morning application. When applied at night, I feel a slight tackiness when I lay my face on a satin pillow case, so I've learned to use an ultra thin application to minimize that feeling. I have paid more for less effective facial products, so this one is definitely a winner for me.

avis.titre: Amazingly Good Serum!
avis.texte: I have a few preferred K-beauty brands and Dr. Reju-All has quickly become one of them! This Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum has been absolutely fantastic so far. I haven’t seen a serum that mixes these particular ingredients together and was super excited to try this—and it has exceeded my expectations already with barely a week of use of it! The Good: -this has a good mix of peptides, PDRN, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, adenosine, and some oils. No ingredients seemed to stand out in the list that raised any concerns. -this is made in Korea by a really excellent brand. -packaging has clear instructions, lists ingredients, and is simple but effective. -this layers incredibly well with other products. When used with other Dr. Reju-All items, it seamlessly blends into the routine and provides a great boost of moisture, plumpness to skin, and makes my face feel like it is retaining that moisture for longer. It also works well with products from other brands, too. My dry skin loves this. I can see a visible difference when I use and I can feel it, too. Skin just feels better with this in my routine somehow. After <1 week of use, I might be imagining it, but I think my skin looks better overall. I don’t have much in the way of wrinkles but I can get dehydration lines because my skin is dry. This erases them and they seem to stay away longer and longer each time. For an even better experience, this works brilliantly with the Dr. Reju-All Advanced PDRN Rejuvenating Cream applied

avis.titre: Nice hydrating serum, but keep expectations realistic about anti-aging claims
avis.texte: Overall, this is a nicely presented serum from a respected K-beauty pharmacy brand. The packaging and formulation give it a premium feel, and at around $25 for 1 oz, I think the value is reasonable for this category. The most noticeable benefit for me is hydration. It helps moisturize the skin and leaves it feeling softer and somewhat more plump. The formula is lightweight enough to incorporate easily into a skincare routine and layers well with other products. It can provide some limited glow, and is largely free of fragrance. The PDRN and copper peptide combination is interesting, and I appreciate seeing these ingredients in a relatively affordable serum. However, I think it's important to keep expectations realistic. Beyond moisturizing and temporarily improving the appearance of the skin through hydration, it's difficult for me to say that I've seen dramatic changes in wrinkles, firmness, elasticity, or other signs of aging. If significant wrinkle reduction or anti-aging is your primary goal, I would discuss more established options with a dermatologist, including prescription treatments such as tretinoin when appropriate, rather than expecting a cosmetic serum like this to produce comparable results. That doesn't make this a bad product. As a hydrating and skin-conditioning serum, I think it performs quite well, and the presentation, ingredients, texture, and overall quality are good for the price. avis.titre: My Skin Definitely Looks Better Using It
avis.texte: At 52 with very dry, post-menopausal skin, I’ve learned to be realistic about skincare. No serum is going to erase decades of aging, lift sagging skin, or magically make wrinkles disappear. What good products can do is improve hydration, support the skin barrier, give skin a healthier appearance, and make lines look softer because the skin is functioning better. That’s where this serum fits for me. The first thing that caught my attention was the manufacturer. This is made by Cosmax, one of Korea’s largest and most respected cosmetic manufacturers, and I’ve had consistently good experiences with products coming out of their facilities. The formula is built around several ingredients that I actively look for. It contains PDRN (Sodium DNA), copper peptides, multiple additional peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, hydrolyzed collagen, panthenol, beta-glucan, allantoin, adenosine, and sodium PCA. Instead of relying on one trendy ingredient, it combines several categories that focus on hydration, skin support, and overall skin quality. Texture is excellent. The serum feels lightweight going on, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave behind a sticky or heavy film. The blue color comes from the copper peptide content, but it disappears completely once applied. It layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen and has not pilled with any of the products in my routine. What I’ve noticed most is improved hydration and a healthier-looking glow. avis.titre: Added to my regime with no adverse reaction! Good product!
avis.texte: This review is for the Dr.Reju-All Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum – GHK-Cu with PDRN Serum for Face – Copper Peptides for Firming & Skin Elasticity – with Hyaluronic Acid & Hydrolyzed Collagen Peptides – 1.01 Fl Oz. I added this to my skincare regime right after my exosome shot PDRN pink collagen 2,000 PPM spicule facial serum and toner pads. I haven’t had a reaction as I hope it absorbs into my skin better with the spicules. I’ve been using this for a couple weeks now and haven’t noticed much difference in changes to my dark spots but have felt it more hydrating after each use. I only use these specific spicule facial serums and copper peptides at night. In the morning, I do feel that my skin is much smoother. It does leave a glow to my skin. Overall, I’m glad this doesn’t have any reaction to my face with all the other skincare products that I use. I have relatively sensitive skin so I’m always careful on what I added to my regime. This didn’t disappoint. Looking forward to positive results as I continue to use.

avis.titre: A refined serum with serious skin-support ingredients
avis.texte: I’ve used PDRN and copper peptides separately in my skincare, so I was curious to try a serum that combines both. First impression: excellent packaging. The frosted bottle feels substantial and well made. The serum has a nice mid-weight texture — not too runny, not too thick — with tiny blue speckles of encapsulated copper peptides that are visible but not felt on the skin. It absorbs almost instantly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and plump. It also layers well with my toner and moisturizer, with no pilling. No noticeable fragrance, which I always appreciate. Ingredient-wise, it’s a strong skin-support formula: PDRN and copper peptides for repair, firmness, and elasticity; hyaluronic acid and hydrolyzed collagen for hydration; and niacinamide, panthenol, beta-glucan, allantoin, and adenosine for barrier support. Very reactive skin may want to patch test, but I don’t see any major red flags. I haven’t used it long enough to speak to major firming results, but so far, I really like it.

avis.titre: Great copper peptide pdrn serum for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This copper peptide PDRN serum works exceptionally well on sensitive skin. Unlike other copper peptide brands that can be sticky and difficult to layer, this formula is non-sticky, spreads evenly, and feels deeply hydrating. The combination of PDRN and copper peptides in a single serum is ideal for anyone dealing with sensitive skin or a compromised skin barrier, as both components function as skin-rejuvenating and anti-aging ingredients. One unique characteristic is that the serum dries down to a powdery finish, leaving a thin layer of residue that feels like powder on both the face and fingers once fully dry. However, the formulation is entirely fragrance-free and causes no negative side effects. After a couple of weeks of consistent use, the skin feels balanced and hydrated. While major improvements such as visible skin tightening or wrinkle reduction are not yet apparent, continued long-term use will be required to evaluate full results.

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: Dr. Reju-All Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum has been an excellent addition to my skincare routine. Finding serums that are gentle enough for my sensitive skin is sometimes a challenge. Many serums combine too many skincare ingredients and fragrances. Dr. Reju-All products have been reliable go-to products for me. The key ingredients of the serum are PDRN, multi-peptides+copper peptides, hyaluronic acid and hydrolyzed collagen. Together they work to restore the skin barrier, support collagen production, deliver hydration and improve skin elasticity. The serum is suitable for both daytime and nighttime use. I love how the serum is lightweight, non-greasy and absorbs easily into my skin. After a few weeks of use, I definitely am starting to notice improvement. With longer term use, I am confident I will continue to see great results. I’m happy to have found a PDRN/Peptide serum that’s gentle enough to add to my normal skincare routine.

avis.titre: Fantastic Formula, Silky Texture, and Beginner-Friendly
avis.texte: I ordered this Advance PDRN Copper Peptide Serum by Dr. Reju-All to add to my skincare routine. What I love about Dr. Reju-All is their very clear instructions on when and how their products should be used. The labeling clearly indicates this is a daily serum that can be used in the morning and the evening as a second step after toner and before moisturizer. If you're a skincare beginner like me, these details are incredibly helpful. It makes Dr. Reju-All so easy to use and understand. The main benefit of this serum is its skin plumping and hydrating properties. They are especially helpful for someone like me in my 40s that is starting to see signs of aging. This serum has a silky, almost gel like consistency that glides on the skin, it absorbs easily and doesn't leave a greasy texture. The formula contains humectants like hyaluronic acid and beta-glucan, multiple peptides and PDRN for anti-aging, and calming ingredients like guaiazulene, panthenol, and allantoin. Overall, this is a solid addition to my skincare routine. It's too early to speak to long term improvements but I love the skin benefits and hydration I've seen so far.

avis.titre: This serum has me all aglow
avis.texte: Dr. Reju-All's Advanced PDRN Copper Peptide Serum earns five stars from me because it contains great ingredients for my aging skin. I've become a fan of Dr. Reju-All's products, and this premium Korean skincare product is no exception. It's especially friendly to my sensitive skin. I love how this lightweight serum feels cool on my skin, and the fact that there is no appreciable odor. It also imparts a subtle glow which I imagine will continue to improve with use. This serum's main ingredients are copper peptides for skin firmness and elasticity, PDRN to replenish and condition the skin, hyaluronic acid for hydration and moisture retention, and collagen peptides for smoothness. The product packaging contains a full list of ingredients and instructions for use. My only criticism is that the print is very small. This serum should be used morning and evening, a few drops on clean skin before applying moisturizer. It can be layered with other serums. One of the things I like about this skincare line is that the products are numbered to indicate the order you should put them on your skin. This is a number two, meaning it should follow your toner.

avis.titre: I love Dr. Reju-All products and this one as well
avis.texte: I have several products made by Dr. Reju-All and I love every single lip serum, peptide, PDRN, ceramide, retinol and peptide I have ever used. I have also previously used other PDRN and copper serums, so I was excited to try this one know how much I have loved the dr. Reju-All line of products. This PDRN copper serum goes on like a thick serum. You can see the blue copper in the serum and it all absorb well into the skin. It feels a bit sticky at first but quickly soaks in and leaves my face feeling hydrated and smooth. This serum is fragrance free for those that prefer fragrance free face serums. The formula contains ingredients like hyaluronic acid and beta-glucan, hydrolyzed collagen, many peptides and PDRN for anti-aging, hydration and plumping of the skin. My skin did not experience any negative or adverse reactions and this serum feels very gentle and hydrating.

avis.titre: An ANTI-AGING POWERHOUSE SERUM Stimulates Collagen Synthesis & Maintains SKIN FIRMNESS!!
avis.texte: I've been looking for a nice copper peptide serum for a while, and this one for Dr. Reju-All absolutely checks all the boxes you may want for one while still coming in at an affordable price point! Copper peptides - a type of carrier peptide made up of copper bound to amino acids which are the building blocks of proteins - are found naturally in the body, but their levels decline with age, so supplementing with a serum is one of the key essentials for an anti-aging skincare regimen. This serum from Dr. Reju All is beautifully formulated, with a smooth PDRN base and blue encapsulated copper, this feels amazing going on and isn't at all sticky or tacky on the skin. In the short term, this provides an immediate burst of moisture and clarity to the skin - and as part of a layering skincare system it's an excellent addition to your daily routine.

avis.titre: Refined Copper Peptide Serum With a Premium Feel
avis.texte: APPLICATION & TEXTURE: This blue serum feels elegant from the first drop. The lightweight fluid absorbs almost instantly and settles into the skin with a smooth refined finish. It layers easily under my morning moisturizer or night cream without any tacky afterfeel. A small amount spreads evenly and covers my entire face. INGREDIENTS & BENEFITS: This formula blends copper peptides, PDRN and niacinamide in a balanced elevated way. These ingredients are known for supporting collagen and helping the skin look smoother and more resilient. The overall feel is refined and premium without being thick. RESULTS & EFFECTS: My skin looks hydrated and plumped right away with a soft natural radiance. It gives my complexion a refreshed smooth appearance that works well under makeup. The formula feels supportive for elasticity and overall firmness which makes it a strong option for early aging care. FINAL THOUGHTS: If you want a weightless aging care serum that performs like a premium product this is an excellent addition to a daily skincare routine. It feels refined, comfortable and effective without being heavy.

avis.titre: Loving this serum!
avis.texte: This gel serum has an absolutely fantastic consistency. When you first apply it, it goes on a little thick, which I actually love because it feels like it really coats and grips the skin. It is completely fragrance free, making it perfect if you are sensitive to heavy scents or just prefer your skincare without any added perfume. It also feels incredibly refreshing and cool the second it touches your face. It sinks in beautifully and leaves my skin feeling perfectly prepped and ready for the next step in my routine. I have really fallen in love with this brand because it is both highly effective and super affordable. There is definitely a reason why it is the number one drugstore brand in Korea. If you are looking for something that delivers great results without breaking the bank, this is a must try.

avis.titre: lightweight serum layers well under hydrators and moisturizers; gentle and free of added fragrance
avis.texte: I was sort of late to the game when it comes to copper peptides. I had a deep fear of what has been termed the "copper uglies," a temporary (hopefully!) issue that mainly arises with overuse or improper formulations or layering. I ordered this serum mainly because the formula looked good, simple and with nothing incompatible. Copper peptides work well layered under hydrators and barrier-targeted moisturizers, and aren't compatible with acidic ingredients, vitamin C, or retinoids. This serum has none of the stronger, incompatible actives, and contains a couple light humectant plant oils plus hydrating/barrier-loving beta glucan. The texture is ideal, not quite watery but definitely not at all sticky or tacky. It doesn't dry to a film on my skin, but rather absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling ready to accept hydration and moisture. Nothing in this serum causes any irritation for me, but I will mention that it does contain niacinamide (something that is compatible with copper peptides, but to which some people report sensitivity). This serum is free of added fragrance and smells neutral to me. This is a good entry-level copper peptide serum, budget-friendly and well-formulated.
